name: youtube-subtitles-srt-quality-gate
purpose: Provider-neutral checks before a human publishes an SRT file to YouTube, TikTok or another video platform.

checks.rule: startMs >= 0 AND endMs > startMs AND startMs >= previous.endMs
checks.failure: Reject overlapping or backwards subtitle intervals.

checks.rule: text is valid UTF-8 and contains no NUL

checks.failure: Keep the file in draft; the template never publishes on the user's behalf.

output.telemetry: Record only aggregate pass/fail counts; do not log audio or caption text.
